svg.text: Slide the black sleeve and two glasses on the card clink, again and again. Your name sits on top.
Simulated: interlaced print and slit sleeve composed column by column, then blurred as the eye would. Then it repeats every 2.1 mm of travel.
Black sleeve 84 x 52 mm, laser-cut slits 0.7 mm. Lemon card 100 x 80 mm: interlaced print
under the window, name above, slotted foot.
print under the slits: three 0.7 mm slices per pitch, one per frame
Slide 0.7 mm: next frame. A 15 mm pull plays the loop 7 times.
Black bars take 2/3 of the light: the picture is dark but sharp,
so the sleeve face is also printed with the name as a lemon label.
